content:
Claude is upgrading its Chrome sidebar into a full Cowork session, allowing tasks and conversations in the browser to follow users across applications.

Claude can now continue browser tasks across all of its applications

Anthropic announced the change today. Conversations started in the sidebar are now saved to the Claude conversation history, where users can pick them up in the Claude desktop, web, and mobile apps.

Skills and connectors already configured in the account also apply in the browser without additional setup. Claude in Chrome can see the current page and act through the user's existing browser login, including clicking links, switching between pages, entering text, and filling out forms.

The example Anthropic gives is that a user can ask Claude to gather invoice data from multiple vendor portals, build a spreadsheet, and then continue the same session in the desktop app to add local files or compare the results against a previous budget.

This update plugs a gap in Claude's browser workflow. Until now, sidebar sessions were siloed from conversations in Claude's other apps, and neither the content nor the context could be carried over.

Anthropic previously highlighted its in-app browser for Claude Code, which runs in a separate profile. The Chrome extension, by contrast, operates directly on sites where the user is already logged in.

Anthropic warns that browser agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks.

With auto-approval enabled, the system applies additional review to higher-impact actions, and Claude still asks before doing things like making purchases or sharing personal data.

The company says these safeguards reduce risk but do not eliminate it.

Availability

The Cowork sidebar is available to Max and Team customers starting today, with Pro plans rolling out over the coming weeks. Enterprise admins can turn the feature on and restrict access to approved domains. Other Chromium browsers and mobile devices are still not supported by Claude in Chrome.

The release is part of Anthropic's ongoing effort to make Claude's workflows seamless across platforms.

Recent updates have also added live iOS app testing in Claude Code for Mac, and new Opus 4.8 controls on more products and devices to support longer-running tasks.
